buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.Data Entry Operator service on outsourcing basis shall be performed by person qualified as per specifica tion ( qualification) of the document. 2.The persons supplied by the agency should not have any adverse police record s/criminal records agains t them. The character and antecedents of each incumbent of the service provider will be got verified by th e service provider and a certificate to this effect to be submitted to WBPHL, Kolkata before deployment. 3. The service provider will ensure that the personnel deployed are medically fit and will keep a record of t heir medical fitness. The service provider shall immediately withdraw such employees who are not found s uitable by this office for any reason s on receipt of such request. 4. The service provider shall engage necessary number of persons as prescribed in the tender. The said pe rsons engaged by t he service provider shall be the employee of the service provider and it shall be the du ty of the service provider to pay their salary every month. The said persons deployed shall not claim any e mployment, compensation, engagement or adsorption in the WBPHL, Kolkata at any time. 5. The service provider’s personnel shall not claim any compensation, benefit, regularization, absorption of service in WBPHL, Kolkata under the provisions of Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 or Contract Labour (Regula tion & Abolition) Act, 1970 or any other act, rules and regulations. Undertaking from the personnel have to be submitted by the service provider to WBPHL Kolkata. 6.The service provider’s personnel shall not divulge any information,details of office, work anytime to any person as these are secret in nature. 7. The service provider’s personnel should be polite, cordial, positive and efficient. Any act of indiscipline o n part of the personnel deployed will not be tolerated. 8.The deployed personnel may be required to sit late and may be called on Saturdays,Sunday and other h olidays, if required. 9. The WBPHL, Kolkata may require the service provider to dismiss or remove from the site of work of pers on/s deployed by the service provider found to be incompetent, misconduct. 10.The service provider has to provide photo identity card to the persons deployed by them. 11. The service provider shall ensure proper conduct of persons deployed by them in the office premises a nd enforce prohibition consumption of alcoholic drinks, pan, smoking, loitering without work. 12.The personnel of t he service provider shall be paid as per the prevailing wages under the Minimum wa g es act 1948 from time to time and also maintain statutory contributions like EPF, ESIC etc. 13. The agency will be wholly responsible for payment of wages to the engaged by it in compliance to all s tatutory obligations under all legislations as applicable to it from time to time including Minimum Wages A ct, Employees Provident Fund , ESI Act etc. and the WBPHL shall not incur any liability for any expenditure whatsoever on the persons employed by the agency on account of any obligation. The agency shall provid e particulars of EPF, ESI deposited in respect of the personnel of its employees engaged for WBPHL, Kolkat a. 14. The service provider s hall submit the bill in the first week of the following month in duplicate along wit h the acquaintance sheet, attendance copy, EPF,ESI and GST challans. In case consolidated challans are su bmitted agency shall also submit a certificate that the amount received by the agency against PF,ESI,GST f rom WDRA in respect of the manpower deployed at WBPHL Kolkata in included in the challans submitted a nd have been deposited to the appropriate authority accounts. Incase of delay service provider make pay ment from their end and not to wait for payment from WBPHL. Kolkata . 15. Payment to the service provider would be strictly on th e certification by the incharge of the laboratory that his/her serviceis satisfactory. 16.The deployed personnel shall seek prior permission if he/she intends to absent himself/herself from wor k. 17.The service provider shall arrange substitute well in advance incase of the person deployed leave the jo b.

18. The service provider shall be contactable at all the times and message sent by telephone/email/ Fax/s pecial messenger from WBPHL to the service provider. The service provider shall strictly observe the instr uctions issued by WBPHL, Kolkata in fulfillment of contract time to time. 19.The WBPHL, Kolkata shall notb e liable for any loss, damage, theft , burglary or robbery of any persons belongings, equipment or vehicles of the personnel of the service provider. 20.The WBPHL Kolkata will maintain an attendance register in respect of the staff deployed at WBPHL, Kol kata on the basis of which wages/remuneration will be paid as per approved rate. 21. The agency shall submit a security deposit of Rs. 10000/- by way of demand draft in favour of “Director , Central Combined Laboratory” which will be released after two months of successful completion of the co ntract period. 22. On the expiry of the contract period the agency will withdraw all its personnel and clear their dues if an y. In case of any dispute on account of the termination of employment or non-employmentof personnel ofa gency, it shall be eitrely the responsibility of the agency to pay and settle the same. 23.In case of any dispute arising in respect of the clauses of the agreement, the matter will be referred to The Director, Central Combined Laboratory, Kolkata and his/her decision shall be final and abiding on both the parties. 24. Participating firms must have prior experience of working with parent,same or auxiliary units in eastern India with a minimum turnover of Rs. 10 lakhs per year or more in the last two years. 25. In case of wages/salary is less than Rs. 30000/- either challan or professional tax registration document may be accepted. 26. The bidder shall quote the financial cost as total monthly remuneration/salary/wages(all inclusive) of e ngagement of one Data Entry Operator per month. 27. The period of deployment is upto March 2027. The period of depolyment may decrease as per decision of the Director, CCL & that should be treated as final to both parties. 28. Total number of personnel to be deployed is two. It can increase or decrease depending on the situatio n as decided by the Director CCL 29. In case of satisfactory service by the vendor, as to be decided by The Director, CCL, the period of deplo yment may be extended upto March 2028. 30. The registered address of the bidder should be in the Kolkata Municipal area 31. specification ( qualification) - Any recognized Bachelor’s degree with computer knowledge and knowle dge about the use of relevant software, tender preparation, Laboratory Information Management System ( LIMS), TALLY etc and any specific experience commensurate to the field. .
